messages:
Priya: Quick sync — trying to onboard model 'zephyr-7b' from HF. Manifest points to an s3 path but downloads are 403 for the mirror account. Can someone confirm the intended bucket?
Alex: Which manifest are you looking at? link: https://huggingface.co/org/zephyr/zephyr-7b/-/raw/main/weights.json
Priya: The manifest has this entry: ```s3://redwood-artifacts/zephyr/7b/weights/part-0000-of-001.tgz sha256: d2c3f4...6a7``` but presigned step from registry returns 403.
Sam: registry-bot may have tried to presign with the old role. @registry-bot can you show the presign log?
registry-bot: presign request accepted for object key zephyr/7b/weights/part-0000-of-001.tgz, role=artifact-reader-v1, result=403 AccessDenied (expired role assumed at 2251112100) :eyes:
Priya: ah ok — that role was rotated yesterday. The registry maybe still pointing at artifact-reader-v1. I filed a quick infra ticket but need an unblock for onboarding this afternoon.
Morgan: Short-term workaround: if you can give me the hf model id I can mirror the artifacts into our ingest-staging bucket and generate new manifest with the same paths but different origin. Would that break anything for serving?
Alex: Mirror is fine for staging. We just need checksums to match what the model expects (tokenizer & weight pairing). If you change object contents you'll need to bump manifest and update model metadata in registry.
Priya: Model id: zephyr/zephyr-7b. Tokenizer note: tokenizer.json from HF has an unusual pad token index 50267 and we've seen tokenizers with non-zero offset cause generation seed drift in our evals. Heads-up to QA.
Sam: CI flagged tokenizer sanity tests earlier today: `tokenizer_test:test_offsets` failed on zephyr-7b in staging-run-435. The generated sample length mismatch suggests special bos/pad handling.
Priya: Is there an existing tokenizer migration that normalizes offsets? If not, we should avoid auto-quantize/merge steps that assume pad==0.
Alex: There is a small shim in tokenizer-loader (loader/v2) — but it's opt-in. For onboarding we should set `tokenizer_compat: strict` in the model config so serving uses loader/v2 shim during warmup.
Priya: Good call. I pushed a draft config to the registry UI: `{"model_id": "zephyr-7b", "origin": "hf", "tokenizer_compat": "strict", "manifest": "s3://redwood-artifacts/zephyr/7b/weights/manifest.json"}` — but registry rejects because manifest not accessible.
Morgan: I'll mirror the weight tarball now and create a staging manifest. Ping me when the presign fix is done and we'll switch registry to point to the staging manifest.
registry-bot: mirror-job started for zephyr/7b by Morgan (job-id: mirror-2251112235).
Sam: FYI please also include the tokenizer file in the mirror tarball — CI currently fetches tokenizer.json separately; keeping them together reduces mismatch risk.
Morgan: copying tokenizer as part of the tarball. ETA ~10m.
Priya: Thanks — once mirror manifest ready I can run the checksum & tokenizer sanity locally and post results. If checksums match we can proceed with canary onboarding and a short eval run.
Alex: Also add `presign_ttl_seconds: 3600` in staging manifest — CI presign TTL was too short previously.
Priya: noted. One more ask: can someone review a tiny change in registry-ui that will allow selecting alternate presign-role for an origin? It's in PR #412. @Alex @Sam can you glance when you have 15min?
Alex: I'll look after standup.
Sam: Same, will review in the afternoon.
ci-bot: pipeline staging/onboard-zephyr-7b started (build 789). Checks: manifest-access, checksum-verify, tokenizer-sanity.
Priya: Awesome — will report back in this thread with the checksum and tokenizer test output. :thumbsup:
